name: fumigator's hood

tags.description: A full-face hood in ochre rubber with a filter drum bolted under the chin, lens scratched to a soft blur by ten thousand hours of it. It isn't armour and was never sold as any. It's the difference between spraying a tunnel and being in a tunnel that has been sprayed, which is a distinction the trade takes very seriously and everyone else finds out about once.
